tool_config.name: record_availability
tool_config.description: Record whether the hotel has a room available for the requested dates and the lowest nightly rate. Call exactly once, after the hotel confirms your repeat-back, before ending the call.

available.description: True if the hotel said a room is available for the requested dates, false if not.

quoted_rate.description: Lowest nightly rate the hotel quoted, as spoken, e.g. '$189'. Empty if no rate was given.

reservation_number.description: Only if the hotel volunteers one. We never book, so this is usually empty.

notes.description: One short sentence summarising the hotel's answer.
